application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
The mixed dual uses distinct real functions at every nonroot vertex and is proved equal to the already audited vertex dual at the root.
The nonempty vertex partition separates the singleton first vertex and pairs the remaining lower and upper faces exactly; no division by a root function is used.
The dimension recursion covers d=0 and arbitrary input functions without unit or nonvanishing assumptions.
The translated expansion requires the shift to belong to Q. Translation invariance of Haar averaging on Q makes the reparametrization exact; no claim is made for shifts outside Q.

One definition and six theorems are individually audited. The expansion is the finite subgroup analogue of the mixed-dual recursive structure used in the concatenation argument; characteristic-factor closure and localization, higher-order concatenation and Bessel remain missing.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
